messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> service=db-connections, severity=critical, incident_id=PD123456
pagerduty: PD: Alert triggered, escalation policy 'DB Oncall' started :rotating_light:
elaine: ack'd. jumping in. seeing pg connections maxed, many 5xx from api-proxy in us-east-1
mike: oncall handover in ~10m if you need deeper db root cause. for now console me
alex: logs from pg host-3:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR connection limit reached: max_connections (500)
active_connections=512 waiting=23
query: SELECT ...
```
elaine: looks like connection pool exhaustion at pgbouncer layer. pgbouncer metrics show clients 600/600, server connections saturated
db-eng: Confirmed. pgbouncer max_client_conn reached, auth/backend queue growing. also elevated server-side long-running queries
sre-rotations: initial mitigation checklist:
- throttle API write-heavy endpoints
- scale pgbouncer replicas
- enable client-side conn pooling fallback (temp)
- identify hot clients
elaine: running quick mitigation: scale pgbouncer in k8s
```
kubectl -n infra scale deploy pgbouncer --replicas=4
```
elaine: scaling started; will also bump max_client_conn on new pods
mike: I'll try to kick long-running queries off replica-2 and promote read-only fallback
mike: running psql on pg-primary to list longest queries
```
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS runtime, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active'
ORDER BY runtime DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
alex: top offenders are a batch job stuck in retry loop + a spike in customer A's backfill
support-bot: Customer impact: increased 502/504 errors and timeouts for ~7% of requests in us-east-1, mostly churned on embeddings endpoints. Ticket created CUST-4212
elaine: quick temp rule: apply rate limit to embeddings-write route at edge
```
redwood-edgectl rate-limit set --route=/v1/embeddings --limit=20/s
```
elaine: pgbouncer pods are up (new replicas ready). observing client_conn drop from 610 -> 420
mike: post-scale, server-side connections still high on pg-primary (480/500). I'll terminate the runaway batch job pid 9876
mike: `select pg_terminate_backend(9876);` -> returns true
alex: after termination, server-side active dropped to 310, queued clients draining
elaine: rolling restart of api-proxy workers to clear stale connections
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy api-proxy
```
mike: adding temporary connection limit adjustments: increased `max_connections` on primary from 500 -> 700 (ephemeral), will monitor.
db-eng: note: increasing max_connections increases memory; we only do this short-term while we mitigate other issues
elaine: alerting SRE to watch for OOM or memory pressure
sre-rotations: can someone confirm whether read-replicas are healthy for offload?
alex: replicas are lagging ~2s but healthy. we can route read traffic for embeddings to replicas as fallback
elaine: switching read routing for embeddings to replica pool
```
redwood-router set-route --service embeddings --prefer-replicas
```
support-bot: update: CUST-4212 now notes partial degradation but no data loss. customers alerted via status page (Incident 2026-03-15-DBCONN)
pagerduty: PD: Incident acknowledged by elaine. escalation paused. next oncall (mike) will take lead in 9m
mike: I'll take lead at handover. elaine, can you assemble short RCA timeline once stabilized? we should capture spike source and consider circuit-breaker at client SDK
elaine: yes. initial theory: a customer backfill job retried aggressively after a transient cache eviction, causing sudden connection spike and long-running queries. need better client backoff and server-side queuing
db-eng: follow-up actions suggested (to-do list):
- add client-side jittered exponential backoff guidance to SDK docs
- add server-side adaptive circuit breaker for embeddings write
- create pgbouncer alert when client_conn > 80% for >2m
- add runbook step to reroute read traffic when pgbouncer degradation detected
mike: I've handed command to elaine. marking as in-progress. keeping PD incident open until metrics stable for 30m
elaine: monitoring: 5xx rate down from 7% -> 1.2% in the last 8m. latency 95p back to baseline. I'll update status page in 15m with a mitigation summary
support-bot: status page updated: "Partial degradation mitigated, monitoring". customers notified.
pagerduty: PD: note added: escalated -> acknowledged -> in progress. Incident assigned to elaine
elaine: thanks team. leaving log snippets + commands in postmortem ticket PM-987
sre-rotations: if anything regresses, re-page and we reconvene. :thumbsup:
